decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation line costs little to keep alongside the growing laser portfolio, and its value is still uncertain given its limited web visibility, so the option stays open, though the new compact cabin may partly overlap with it.
After the thermal inkjet model was withdrawn, the piezo printer is the firm's main high-resolution inkjet offer, it has its own page, and no negative signal justifies abandoning it.
The industrial laser marking line is the flagship of the firm's direction and is featured on the home page, so the firm is committing further rather than holding a cheap option.
The newly launched compact laser cabin extends the laser line cheaply, and its prospects are still unresolved after one year, so the option is worth keeping open.
The award at Blechexpo is a positive early signal for this specialized lubricant printing system, which opens a sheet metal niche at low marginal cost, so it is kept.
